description: An introduction to databases and database management systems, covering data organisation, primary keys, data types, queries, forms, reports and the benefits of databases over manual filing.

options.text: A single document containing one page of text
An organised collection of related data stored together
A program used to draw pictures on a computer
A device used to print documents

mcq.explanation: A database is an organised collection of related data that is stored so it can be easily accessed, managed and updated.

mcq.questionText: What does the abbreviation DBMS stand for?
mcq.explanation: DBMS stands for Database Management System, the software used to create and manage databases.

mcq.questionText: In a database table, a single column that holds one category of information, such as 'Surname', is called a:
mcq.explanation: A field is a single column that stores one specific category of data about each item.

mcq.questionText: A complete set of information about one item, such as all details of a single student, is known as a:
mcq.explanation: A record is a complete group of related fields describing one item, usually stored as one row in a table.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is an example of database software?
mcq.explanation: Microsoft Access is a popular DBMS, while the others are presentation, image-editing and media programs.

mcq.questionText: What is the main purpose of a primary key in a database table?

options.text: To make the text in a field appear bold
To uniquely identify each record in the table
To change the colour of the table

mcq.explanation: A primary key uniquely identifies each record so that no two records share the same key value.

mcq.questionText: Which data type would be most suitable for storing a person's date of birth?
mcq.explanation: The Date/Time data type is designed to store dates and times correctly so they can be sorted and calculated.

mcq.questionText: A database object used to search for and display only the records that meet certain conditions is called a:
mcq.explanation: A query is used to ask the database questions and return only the records matching the chosen conditions.

mcq.questionText: Which database object is mainly used to enter and view data one record at a time in a user-friendly layout?
mcq.explanation: A form provides an easy on-screen layout for entering and viewing one record at a time.

mcq.questionText: A report in a database is mainly designed to:

options.text: Connect the computer to the internet
Present data in a neat, printable format
Protect the database with a password
Convert the database into a video

mcq.explanation: A report organises and formats data so it can be printed or presented in a clear, professional way.

mcq.questionText: Which data type is best suited for a field that should store only the values True or False?
mcq.explanation: The Yes/No (Boolean) data type stores logical values such as Yes/No or True/False.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is an advantage of using a computerised database over a manual paper filing system?

options.text: It always requires more storage space
It makes searching for information much faster
It can never be backed up
It makes data harder to update

mcq.explanation: A computerised database allows fast searching, sorting and updating compared with slow manual paper filing.

mcq.questionText: In a database table, the rows and columns together are organised into a structure called a:
mcq.explanation: A table stores data in rows (records) and columns (fields) and is the basic building block of a database.

mcq.questionText: Why should a phone number usually be stored using the Text data type rather than the Number data type?

options.text: Because phone numbers are used in calculations
Because leading zeros must be kept and no arithmetic is needed
Because Text fields cannot store letters
Because Number fields can store more characters

mcq.explanation: Phone numbers are not used in calculations and may begin with a zero, which a Number field would remove, so Text is preferred.

mcq.questionText: Which statement best describes the relationship between data, a field and a record?

options.text: A record is made of fields, and each field holds an item of data
A field is made of records, and each record holds a table
Data is made of records, and each record holds a query
A field and a record mean exactly the same thing

mcq.explanation: Individual items of data fill fields, and a group of related fields together forms one record.

fib.questionText: An organised collection of related data stored in a computer is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A database stores related data in an organised way for easy access and management.

fib.questionText: The software used to create, manage and control a database is known as a _____.
fib.explanation: A Database Management System (DBMS) is the program that handles the creation and control of databases.

fib.questionText: A single column in a table that holds one category of information is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A field stores one specific type of data, such as 'Name' or 'Age', for every record.

fib.questionText: A complete set of related fields about one item, shown as one row, is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A record holds all the field values for a single item, usually as one row in the table.

fib.questionText: A field that uniquely identifies each record in a table is known as the _____.
fib.explanation: The primary key ensures that every record can be told apart because its value is unique.

fib.questionText: A database object used to search for records that meet certain conditions is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A query retrieves only the records that match the conditions you set.

fib.questionText: A database object that gives a friendly screen layout for entering data one record at a time is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A form makes data entry and viewing easier by showing one record in a clear layout.

fib.questionText: A database object used to present data in a neat, printable format is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A report formats data so it can be printed or presented professionally.

fib.questionText: The data type used to store monetary amounts such as prices is called _____.
fib.explanation: The Currency data type formats numbers as money, often including a currency symbol.

fib.questionText: A popular Microsoft DBMS used to create databases on desktop computers is Microsoft _____.
fib.explanation: Microsoft Access is a widely used desktop database management system.

tf.questionText: A database is simply an organised collection of related data.
tf.explanation: By definition, a database stores related data in an organised structure.

tf.questionText: In a database table, a record is the same thing as a single column.
tf.explanation: A record is a row of related fields; a column is a field, not a record.

tf.questionText: A primary key can have the same value in two different records of the same table.
tf.explanation: A primary key must be unique, so no two records can share the same primary key value.

tf.questionText: A query can be used to display only the records that satisfy a chosen condition.
tf.explanation: Queries filter the data and return only matching records.

tf.questionText: Microsoft PowerPoint is an example of database management software.
tf.explanation: PowerPoint is presentation software; Microsoft Access is the database program.

tf.questionText: Forms are mainly used to make entering and viewing data easier for the user.
tf.explanation: Forms provide a clear, user-friendly layout for data entry and viewing.

tf.questionText: Searching for information in a computerised database is generally slower than in a manual paper file.
tf.explanation: Computerised databases allow much faster searching than manual paper filing.

tf.questionText: Choosing the correct data type for a field helps the database store and validate data properly.
tf.explanation: Correct data types ensure data is stored, sorted and validated correctly.

tf.questionText: A report is mainly used to present and print data in a neat format.
tf.explanation: Reports format data for clear presentation and printing.

tf.questionText: Storing a telephone number using the Number data type always keeps any leading zeros.
tf.explanation: The Number data type removes leading zeros, so phone numbers are better stored as Text.

hoq.questionText: A school keeps a 'Students' table where each student has a unique admission number, plus a 'Marks' table that records the marks of each student. Which design choice best lets the school link a student to their marks correctly?

options.text: Use the student's first name to match the two tables
Use the admission number as a primary key and reference it in the Marks table
Store all marks inside the Students table as one Text field
Avoid using any key field so the tables stay simple

hoq.explanation: A unique admission number used as a primary key can be referenced in the Marks table, reliably linking each student to their marks even if names repeat.

hoq.questionText: A librarian wants to print a list of only the books that are currently borrowed and not yet returned, arranged neatly for display on a notice board. Which combination of database objects is most appropriate?

options.text: A form to view all books, then a primary key to print them
A query to select borrowed books, then a report to format and print them
A report to select the books, then a field to print them
A table only, with no query or report

hoq.explanation: A query filters out only the borrowed books, and a report formats those results neatly for printing.

hoq.questionText: A shop owner stores product prices in a field and wants to be able to total the prices and show them with a money symbol, while also storing product codes that may begin with a zero. Which data type choice is most suitable?

options.text: Prices as Text and product codes as Number
Prices as Currency and product codes as Text
Both prices and product codes as Number
Both prices and product codes as Yes/No

hoq.explanation: Currency allows totalling prices with a money symbol, while Text preserves leading zeros in product codes that a Number field would remove.
